hook: Your toilet in space would strap you down.
title: Your Space Toilet Straps You Down
description:
Astronaut toilets on the ISS use moving air instead of gravity. Fans create suction, and thigh restraints keep the astronaut in place. Nothing falls on its own in orbit, so the airflow does the work.

#Shorts #Space #ISS
comment_prompt: Would you use it? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your toilet in space would strap you down.
scenes.headline: STRAPPED IN

scenes.narration: Without that, you would float right off.
scenes.headline: YOU'D FLOAT OFF

scenes.narration: Bars hold your thighs against the seat.
scenes.headline: THIGH BARS

scenes.narration: There is no flush with water.
scenes.headline: NO WATER FLUSH

scenes.narration: Fans pull everything away with moving air.
scenes.headline: AIR SUCTION

scenes.narration: Nothing falls on its own up there.
scenes.headline: NOTHING FALLS

scenes.narration: Suction does the job gravity can't.
scenes.headline: SUCTION > GRAVITY

scenes.narration: So yes, your toilet would hold you down.
scenes.headline: STRAPPED IN
